description: This Java class is the default implementation of a public health endpoint configuration. It encapsulates a configuration property called 'cacheTimeout' which defines how long to cache public health data, and provides methods to instantiate the configuration from a given Config object, as well as standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultPublicHealthConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing PublicHealthConfig interface, providing configuration for public health endpoint with a cache timeout setting.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DefaultPublicHealthConfig instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getCacheTimeout
methods.description: Returns the cache timeout duration for the public health data.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare cacheTimeout values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration.
